commit 4457d451aad63ed7ac4ef259200d165d157f1554
Author: StalkR <stalkr@stalkr.net>
Date:   Wed Sep 16 09:05:55 2020 +0000

    MCInst: fix uninitialized value in operand value (#1684)

    https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=14912
---
 MCInst.c | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/MCInst.c b/MCInst.c
index a87c30d2..a9ac3b0d 100644
--- a/MCInst.c
+++ b/MCInst.c
@@ -21,6 +21,7 @@ void MCInst_Init(MCInst *inst)

        for (i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
                inst->Operands[i].Kind = kInvalid;
+               inst->Operands[i].ImmVal = 0;
        }

        inst->Opcode = 0;
